body:
GD WCAG 1.1.1 ICON-ONLY ELEMENT AUDIT
Files scanned: index.html, exam.html
Date: 2026-02-22

AUDIT RESULTS: 2 icon-adjacent elements worth noting, 0 hard failures.

ELEMENTS REVIEWED:

exam.html:
1. Back arrow (←) — <a aria-label='Back to dashboard'>
   STATUS: PASS. aria-label present. Screen reader gets full label.

2. Hint buttons: emoji + text ('💡 HINT', '📖 SHOW ANSWER', '📝 SOLUTION STEPS')
   STATUS: PASS. Emoji is decorative here, text is the accessible name. Not icon-only.

3. Graph buttons: text-only ('ADD VERTICAL ASYMPTOTE', 'CHECK GRAPH', 'CLEAR')
   STATUS: PASS. All have visible text.

index.html:
4. SVG chart — role='img' aria-label='Score progress chart showing N tests'
   STATUS: PASS. aria-label set dynamically in buildChart() JS at chart render time.

5. Export button: '📤 Send Scores to Dad'
   STATUS: PASS. Emoji is decorative, text is the label.

6. Load button: '📥 Load Corrected Scores' (label wraps file input)
   STATUS: PASS. Label text visible and correct.

7. Progress bars: role='progressbar' aria-valuenow + aria-valuemin + aria-valuemax
   STATUS: PASS. Numeric values programmatic. Missing aria-label for the standard name.
   NOTE: Each bar reads '53%' but not '53% on standard W2.b'. Screen reader gets the number but not the dimension.
   RECOMMENDATION: Add aria-label='[standard] [pct]%' to each .std-bar.

SUMMARY:
- 0 hard WCAG 1.1.1 failures
- 1 enhancement gap: std-bar progress bars have numeric values but not dimension labels
- All interactive emoji elements pass (emoji decorative, text label is the accessible name)

SPEC FILED TO GA:
Add aria-label to each std-bar: aria-label='[q.standard]: [pct]%'
Location: index.html buildStandards() line ~645
GA implementation: 1 line addition to the progress bar html string.
subject: GD Task 9 output - Icon-only WCAG 1.1.1 audit
